notes.title: A Brief but Much Needed Status Update
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello, monster-lovers.[/b][/i] It's been some time since your last trip to Edelton, the twilight town of rose and ash.

Those of you who follow us on social media know we've been hard at work on supplementary content. Some of that should be coming to Steam, when it's complete.

As always, we're very grateful for your patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43830321/b0ad0761bca885e3a80ef46e4d5a6af488d98ca9.png[/img]

Dark things continue to bubble just beneath the surface in "Garden of Roses." Early on in the story, Will compares the town to something like "a beautiful piece of metal that's lost its luster." Without spoiling too much, this is definitely an understatement in reference to certain characters, who've been cut a raw deal by life and have lost most, if not all, of their shine.

The story of Garden of Roses is pretty on its surface, but full of dark and morbid implications when you take a moment to smell the roses and read between the lines.

Art assets have been chugging along smoothly, while writing/editing is taking a good bit longer.

There are a lot of pieces to link together, and a lot of editing to be done to ensure that everything flows together smoothly. Fortunately, we have a lot of other content (both spicy and tame) to keep you satisfied while we continue to progress.

We hope you enjoyed your brief stay in Edelton, and hope you'll take a pit stop in one or more of our other IPs as we continue to prep your final journey.

Please, stay tuned.
